Name: Balanced Charcoal Output
Author: 66rayyan99
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
[quote]This mod fixes the illogical coal production in Stardew Valley. Why waste 10 wood for a single piece of coal? This tweak balances the game by making the Charcoal Kiln more efficient and rewarding for your hard work.[/quote][b]Installation instructions[/b]
[quote][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][/quote][b]Main features[/b]
[quote][list]
[*]Changes the Charcoal Kiln recipe: [b]1 Wood = 10 Coal[/b].[/*]
[*]Reduces the frustration of wood grinding.[/*]
[*]Fully compatible with Stardew Valley [b]1.6[/b].[/*]
[/list][/quote][b]Requirements[/b]
[quote][list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list][/quote][b]Shout outs[/b]
[quote][list]
[*]Thanks to ConcernedApe for this amazing game.[/*]
[*]Thanks to the SDV Discord/Community for the inspiration to start modding![/*]
[/list][/quote]
